geopolitics.label: Geopolitics

nodes.title: US–China strategic competition remains the primary geopolitical axis
facts: Export controls on advanced semiconductors and manufacturing equipment remain in force.
Both sides continue to deepen security partnerships with regional partners.
nodes.interpretation: This axis transmits into tech supply chains, capital allocation, and military posture; second-order effects dominate most other domains.

geopolitics.summary: 1 node(s). Top: US–China strategic competition remains the primary geopolitical axis

macroeconomics.label: Macroeconomics

nodes.title: Global policy rates remain elevated vs 2010s baseline
facts: Major advanced-economy policy rates are still well above the post-GFC low decade averages.
Inflation has cooled from peaks in many economies but services inflation and fiscal deficits keep policy uncertain.
nodes.interpretation: Higher-for-longer or staggered cuts both reprice duration, risk assets, and the USD — critical for treasury liquidity and BTC beta.

macroeconomics.summary: 1 node(s). Top: Global policy rates remain elevated vs 2010s baseline

energy.label: Energy

nodes.title: AI data-center load and grid constraints lift nuclear and firm power narratives
facts: Hyperscalers have announced long-dated power purchase interest including nuclear-linked supply.
Uranium fuel-cycle capacity remains tight relative to announced reactor and SMR ambitions.
nodes.interpretation: Energy scarcity becomes a binding constraint on AI scale-out; nuclear miners/utilities and grid equipment sit at the intersection of Energy and AI bets.

energy.summary: 1 node(s). Top: AI data-center load and grid constraints lift nuclear and firm power narratives

technology_ai.label: Technology / AI

nodes.title: Frontier AI remains compute- and energy-constrained
facts: Leading labs continue multi-billion-dollar training and inference buildouts.
Advanced GPU/accelerator supply and packaging remain bottlenecks.
nodes.interpretation: Personal leverage from AI tooling scales with model capability, but investable exposure is concentrated in semis, power, and platforms.

technology_ai.summary: 1 node(s). Top: Frontier AI remains compute- and energy-constrained

military.label: Military

nodes.title: Indo-Pacific force posture and industrial base remain priority theaters
facts: Allied exercises and basing arrangements in the Indo-Pacific continue to expand in tempo.
Defense industrial capacity (munitions, shipbuilding, missiles) is a stated bottleneck for multiple governments.
nodes.interpretation: Military posture reinforces export-control and dual-use tech regimes; watch for escalation risk premiums in Asia supply chains.

military.summary: 1 node(s). Top: Indo-Pacific force posture and industrial base remain priority theaters

demographics.label: Demographics

nodes.title: Advanced-economy aging and tight labor markets constrain growth potential
facts: Working-age population growth is slow or negative in several major economies.
Labor force participation and immigration policy remain central political variables.
nodes.interpretation: Demographics support structurally higher wage/inflation volatility and automation demand (AI/robotics leverage thesis).

demographics.summary: 1 node(s). Top: Advanced-economy aging and tight labor markets constrain growth potential

supply_chains.label: Supply Chains

nodes.title: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing remains geographically concentrated
facts: Leading-edge logic capacity is highly concentrated in a small number of firms and locations.
Friend-shoring and subsidy programs aim to diversify capacity over multi-year horizons.
nodes.interpretation: Concentration is a systemic risk node linking geopolitics, AI compute, and capital expenditure cycles.

supply_chains.summary: 1 node(s). Top: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing remains geographically concentrated

capital_flows.label: Capital Flows

nodes.title: Bitcoin remains a high-beta expression of global liquidity and risk appetite
facts: Spot BTC ETFs and corporate treasury narratives have expanded institutional access channels.
BTC drawdowns and rallies remain correlated with broader risk-asset and real-rate moves in many regimes.
nodes.interpretation: For a Bitcoin accumulation thesis, watch real rates, USD liquidity, ETF flows, and regulatory clarity as first-order drivers.

capital_flows.summary: 1 node(s). Top: Bitcoin remains a high-beta expression of global liquidity and risk appetite

climate_resources.label: Climate / Resources

nodes.title: Critical minerals and water stress bind energy transition and industrial policy
facts: Copper, lithium, and rare earths face multi-year project lead times relative to demand forecasts.
Regional drought and heat events increasingly affect hydro and thermal power reliability.
nodes.interpretation: Resource bottlenecks interact with AI power demand and defense industrial needs; not purely a green-narrative story.

climate_resources.summary: 1 node(s). Top: Critical minerals and water stress bind energy transition and industrial policy

narrative_information.label: Narrative / Information Environment

nodes.title: AI and crypto narratives oscillate between euphoria and disillusionment in media cycles
facts: Coverage volume of generative AI remains elevated across business and tech media.
Retail and institutional narratives around Bitcoin flip with price regimes.
nodes.interpretation: Narrative intensity is a sentiment input, not a fundamental; use low confidence unless corroborated by capital-flow or policy facts.

narrative_information.summary: 1 node(s). Top: AI and crypto narratives oscillate between euphoria and disillusionment in media cycles
